These initiatives will encompass vehicle-entry limitations, reduced office attendance, and increased parking fees. To mitigate dust emissions, outdoor construction will face grave restrictions during winter. Residents and vehicle owners are urged to comply to enhance city air quality. Furthermore, traffic patterns will be adjusted to reroute through-traffic away from Delhi.

The incident occurred at Kempegowda International Airport, causing significant distress to his family. Agarwal stated that even his children unknowingly consumed the non-vegetarian food served to them. He requested an investigation by the relevant authorities regarding the matter. Airport officials acknowledged the incident and are currently conducting an internal review to understand the situation.

While many protests were peaceful, some demonstrators engaged in violent confrontations with security forces. Participants included a coalition of youth organisations seeking change regarding economic inequality and public services.

description: India defeated Sri Lanka 54-20 to win the inaugural men’s Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship 2026 in Ahmedabad. Aditya Shinde led the attack with 10 raid points, while Yogesh Dahiya impressed in defence. India completed a historic double after the women’s team also won gold earlier. The men finished unbeaten, securing eight victories throughout the tournament.

Once he was intoxicated, one lover strangled him while the other restrained him. Afterward, they disposed of his body in a lake to conceal the crime. The police have arrested all three individuals and have charged them accordingly.

Following her father's death, she reevaluated career goals and embraced a simpler life. Living in a rural village in Nepal brings both challenges and contentment, influencing her financial decisions. She operates a personal assistant business based in the UK, allowing her to balance work and life in Nepal.

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Discovered in the vast Sahara Desert, the meteorite Teghaza 001 is over four billion years old and is confirmed to be a Martian rock via isotopic studies. This intriguing specimen reveals a volcanic history intertwined with water activity, indicating a complex water cycle on Mars. As researchers delve deeper into its origins, they are unraveling vital insights into the planet's early environmental conditions.
title: 4.1bn-year-old pink Mars rock found in Sahara holds clues to ancient water

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A legal battle erupted between a California restaurant and the family of a golfer regarding a surprise catering bill. The eatery served meals during the prestigious Masters tournament without prior discussion of costs. After leaving prematurely, the family was charged nearly $75,000, which they contested in court. Ultimately, the jury awarded the restaurant $60,391, albeit the request for extra attorney fees was mostly denied.
title: Golfer's family billed $74,960 for Masters meals; court allows $1,950 fees

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: The evacuation of Oleshky's residents marks a significant humanitarian effort as they navigated through Crimea, Russia, and Belarus during a temporary ceasefire. With the aid of buses, this complex journey, affirmed by Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, reunited families after long separations. The perilous living conditions and food scarcity pushed these individuals to leave their homes, ultimately finding refuge in the Chernihiv region of Ukraine.

description: In Cooch Behar district, a woman named Priya Pal lost her baby after an assault on her husband. The alleged attack involved suspected BJP workers who targeted her husband, Debajit Barman, while he was returning home. After the incident, both Priya and Debajit were admitted to the hospital for treatment. Two suspects have been arrested, while a search is ongoing for additional accused individuals.

The defeat also cost them the No.1 spot in the ICC Test rankings, with South Africa taking over. New Zealand lead the WTC table, while India sit fourth. Australia next face New Zealand at home in December.

He ordered the deactivation of login IDs used by voter registration centre operators. Following an inquiry, an outsourced computer assistant was terminated for their alleged involvement. District election officers have been instructed to verify the deactivation of these IDs promptly. The CEO emphasized the importance of maintaining the integrity of electoral roll management.

At his funeral held at the Versova crematorium, close associates like Sanjay Dutt and Milap Zaveri reflected on Gupta's remarkable contributions, leaving the cinema world facing a profound loss.

Ireland won the match by 130 runs to level the five-match series 2-2, with the decider scheduled for Sunday.

description: North Korea has developed a sophisticated cyberwar machine enabling it to target financial institutions worldwide. The country's state-sponsored hackers increasingly rely on social engineering and malware to infiltrate cryptocurrency companies. Cyber operations are essential for generating funds due to international sanctions and economic isolation. Reports suggest that North Korea has stolen billions in cryptocurrency through extensive cybercriminal activity. These actions directly support its military programs and other state priorities.

description: Researchers from the University of Cambridge conducted computer simulations to examine the role of comets in life's origins. The study found that high-speed impacts likely destroyed important chemicals, such as hydrogen cyanide. Only a small percentage of simulations indicated successful delivery of these compounds by comets. Additionally, most impacts during early Earth history could not deliver intact organic molecules.

description: Abhijeet Dipke shared his disappointment regarding Diljit Dosanjh's distancing from a student protest. During a concert, Dosanjh defended his choice to remain silent about social issues. Dipke emphasized his long-standing admiration for Dosanjh despite their disagreement on this matter. Meanwhile, Dosanjh reiterated his commitment to love and support for all Punjabis during his performance. The singer addressed criticisms related to his film 'Satluj' and urged unity among the community.

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: In a remarkable find in 2003, archaeologists unveiled a cosmetic cream container dating back almost 2,000 years in London. Composed of animal fat, starch, and tin oxide, this ancient formula likely served as a moisturizer. Researchers painstakingly recreated the cream to explore its texture and look on the skin, shedding light on the beauty rituals of the past and our enduring human connection to history.

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: In 1900, a remarkable discovery was made when divers stumbled upon the Antikythera Mechanism amidst a shipwreck in the Mediterranean Sea. Researchers found it capable of calculating astronomical cycles and predicting eclipses, intertwining science with the cultural tapestry of ancient Greece.

While Tata Sons is not publicly traded, its subsidiary companies are required to follow SEBI regulations. The regulatory authority has confirmed its vigilant oversight of governance-related events within the group. Additionally, seven listed Tata Group firms have a stake in Tata Sons, and Tata Trusts holds the majority with approximately 66 percent shares.

After being hospitalized due to the assault, Pradeep expressed his distress and received threats from the girl's family. On October 30, Pradeep was found to have died by suicide in the hospital's toilet.

The incident, which occurred on October 19 in Kavaserry, left Sulaiman with critical injuries. He was initially treated at a private hospital before being transferred to Thrissur Medical College Hospital. Unfortunately, he succumbed to his injuries late Friday night during treatment. The grandson has been apprehended and charged with murder following Sulaiman's death.

This expansive property boasts eight bedrooms and 15 bathrooms, along with one-of-a-kind features like a candy room and a nightclub. Acquired in December 2014 after selling Mojang to Microsoft, this listing highlights both the opulence of the home and the difficulties of navigating the high-end Los Angeles real estate landscape.

Its distinct colouring results from natural radiation exposure during its geological formation. Notably, the Ocean Dream was previously showcased at the Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History in 2003.

This sale marks a poignant shift as they prepare to embrace a new chapter in Taylors Lakes.

Iran remains poised to retaliate against any aggressive actions by its adversaries.

author: SANJAY SHARMA
description: Indian artist and educator Rouble Nagi has won the $1 million GEMS Education Global Teacher Prize 2026 for transforming neglected walls into interactive learning spaces for children in underserved communities. Through her Rouble Nagi Art Foundation, she has established over 800 learning centres across more than 100 communities, helping over one million children access formal education. Nagi plans to use the prize money to establish a Skilling Institute offering free vocational and digital literacy training.
title: From slum walls to classrooms: Mumbai artist wins $1 million Global Teacher Prize

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: Hundreds of residents were evacuated from the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky during a humanitarian ceasefire. The evacuation allowed individuals to leave amidst dire conditions of starvation and exhaustion. Three planes carrying evacuees successfully landed at an airport in Belarus as part of a coordinated operation. Both Russian and Ukrainian authorities confirmed the operation was conducted without any incidents.
title: Hundreds evacuated from Oleshky as Melania Trump brokers rare Russia-Ukraine ceasefire

author: ROHITASHWA RANJAN
title: NC rift widens: J&K minister dismisses impact of MP Ruhullah's exit

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: The Brazilian pit viper, Bothrops jararaca, has been a focal point in research leading to significant medical breakthroughs. In the 1960s, Sergio Ferreira uncovered a peptide from this snake that plays a crucial role in blood pressure regulation. This groundbreaking discovery eventually paved the way for captopril, the pioneering ACE inhibitor approved in 1981, which has transformed the treatment landscape for hypertension and heart ailments.
title: How a Brazilian snake's venom led to a widely used blood pressure drug

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In 2019, electrician Petar Tubic stumbled upon a deserted bear cub named Masa in the woods. Over time, he nurtured Masa, eventually establishing a sanctuary for rescued animals, which now includes an additional bear, Ljubica. However, Tubic is troubled by their strong human bonds, raising concern over the bears' future. The sanctuary has transformed into a community attraction and draws attention to the complexities involved in wildlife rescue.
title: Man rescued a 2kg bear cub; the 150kg bear still tries to sit on his lap

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: The historic basilica in Asheville, North Carolina, recently marked the successful completion of its first restoration phase, costing $7.7 million. This essential initiative concentrated on addressing water damage and safeguarding the architectural masterpiece. Key upgrades included the replacement of the copper dome and reinforcing key masonry sections, paving the way for future restoration phases that rely on ongoing fundraising efforts and the building's status as a cultural treasure.
title: 117-year-old US basilica reopens after $7.7m restoration; more work ahead

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: The Centre took significant steps on October 31 by eliminating the Rs 2.5 per litre duty on petrol exports. In contrast, the excise duties for high-speed diesel and aviation turbine fuel were ramped up; diesel duties increased from Rs 8.5 to Rs 11.5 per litre, and ATF duties from Rs 10.5 to Rs 11.
title: Centre scraps Rs 2.5/litre petrol export duty, hikes diesel levy to Rs 11.5

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Sikandar Raza smashed an unbeaten 106 off 56 balls against Afghanistan in the second T20I, becoming the oldest Full Member nation batter to score a T20I century at 40 years and 188 days. Despite his historic knock and an unbeaten 120-run stand with Tafadzwa Tsiga, Zimbabwe lost by 19 runs. Afghanistan posted 221/7 to seal the series 2-0.
title: World record at 40! Raza smashes unbeaten ton against Afghanistan, enters elite list

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A Georgia woman who won $975,000 after a fall at a Walmart store in 2020 will face a new trial after an appeals court overturned the verdict on October 29. The court found that her lawyer had improperly compared compensation for pain and suffering with an expert witness's $8,000 daily fee and minimum-wage rates. Judges ruled that these unrelated comparisons could have influenced the jury's decision.
title: Walmart shopper's $975,000 verdict tossed over lawyer's $8,000 fee remark

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Akhilesh Yadav condemned Amit Shah's claims about the BJP's stronghold in Uttar Pradesh, pointing out the alarming rise in violence against women and Dalits. Responding to Shah's confidence in the BJP's future following recent electoral defeats, MP Awadhesh Prasad underscored the party's vulnerabilities. Shah also emphasized the intent to implement the Uniform Civil Code as part of the BJP's agenda, highlighting the shifting political landscape in the state.
title: 'Already been uprooted': Akhilesh, Awadhesh target Amit Shah over 'Angad's foot' remark

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Elon Musk's AI company xAI is seeking to buy homes in Southaven, Mississippi for employee housing. The company proposed purchasing 418 homes while requesting homeowners not to join a lawsuit related to noise. Residents are unhappy with the ongoing noise from nearby gas turbines at xAI's power plant. Some residents have already expressed their refusal to comply with the company's conditions for selling their homes.
title: Musk's AI firm is targeting homes near its Mississippi data center with buyout offers

author: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI
description: The 37-year-old was not included in India's squad for the five-match ODI series against New Zealand, with Axar Patel currently the team's first-choice left-arm finger spinner.
title: 'Not looking at him for white-ball cricket': Is Jadeja's ODI career over?

author: RAJEEV SINGH
title: 'It’s done bro': J&K CM Abdullah, Nidhi Razdan share photos of their 'new journey'

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: From November 1, telecom operators will implement Calling Name Presentation, changing how incoming calls are displayed. This new feature will show caller names for both saved and unsaved numbers, depending on subscriber details. International calls will be labeled as 'International Call' regardless of the user's saved contacts. Businesses and users with bulk connections can register preferred names subject to verification requirements.
title: No more unknown calls! Govt mandates displaying names - here's what changes from Nov 1

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: People often find joy in viewing purchases as additions to collections rather than isolated items. This perspective shifts focus towards the experience of searching and acquiring meaningful objects. Retailers utilize collecting strategies to encourage consumers to build sets and return for more items. Research indicates that this mindset can influence spending and price evaluations, impacting consumer behavior. Overall, the process of collecting infuses purchases with emotional resonance beyond mere functionality.
title: Psychology says a collecting mindset can make shopping more enjoyable

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Excavations at the Las Minillas site in Spain have unveiled substantial copper mining activities dating back to the Late Bronze Age. Investigations revealed a chemical link between the site and bronze artifacts discovered in Scandinavia. Researchers noted extensive mining operations and identified numerous nearby mining locations, indicating that southern Iberia was crucial for copper supply in Europe during this period.
title: Ancient Spanish copper mine may be linked to 11 Scandinavian bronze objects

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In a creative effort to restore the eelgrass meadows of Long Island Sound, volunteers in Connecticut have adopted an innovative technique. By attaching eelgrass seeds to clam shells, they facilitate the seeds' ability to embed into the seabed, leading to improved growth rates. Although early results show higher eelgrass coverage, there are ongoing concerns about long-term resilience. This initiative is a prime example of community-driven, nature-based environmental restoration strategies.
title: Connecticut's eelgrass shrank 90%; volunteers now plant seeds on clams

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: Anti-Netanyahu bloc weighs direct PM election bill to break political deadlock

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: To bolster security around Mar-a-Lago estate, the United States has installed Avenger air defense systems. These advanced systems address potential airborne threats like drones and low-flying aircraft, responding to a heightened need highlighted by the US Secret Service. Equipped with Stinger missiles, the Avenger system effectively counters various aerial dangers, illustrating the growing concerns related to unmanned aerial vehicles in contemporary security threats.
title: US rolls out Stinger missiles to shield Trump's Florida estate from drone threats

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Joey Brown endured a life-changing gas explosion that led to severe burns and extensive surgeries. He regained independence through employment with support from his community and vocational rehabilitation services. While working in a high school cafeteria, he developed meaningful relationships and has become an encouragement to others. Brown is now aiming to buy his own home and adopt a beagle named Snoopy.
title: After surviving 85% burns at 21, man helps feed hundreds of US students

author: SUHAS BIRHADE
description: Eight individuals suffered injuries when a lift malfunctioned and fell in Dhananjay Avenue, Nalasopara. Residents reported that the lift dropped suddenly while occupants were traveling to the ground floor. Witnesses helped rescue those trapped inside the lift and transported them to a local hospital. Among the injured was advocate Satish Bhondve, along with his guests who were in the lift.
title: Lift crashes down at high speed in Mumbai suburban's 7-storey building; 8 injured

author: KARAN MANRAL
title: 'Public impeachment' of CEC Gyanesh Kumar: INDIA bloc event to begin shortly

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Mark Cuban made a significant decision after selling his software company, choosing to stop wearing a watch. He believes that wearing a watch implies working on someone else's schedule rather than his own. Cuban's focus was not solely on wealth accumulation but on achieving control over his time and life. His early experiences shaped his drive to succeed and prove others wrong throughout his career.
title: Mark Cuban's first move after making $2 million was to take off his watch

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
description: Arunachal Pradesh CM Pema Khandu has assured residents that the proposed 11,200-MW Siang hydropower project will not be imposed on them, saying a decision will be taken only after its feasibility report is completed. The project, seen as a strategic counter to China's mega dam upstream, faces opposition from indigenous Adi communities over displacement, submergence of villages and environmental concerns.
title: 'Won't move forward without public': Arunachal CM amid protests over Siang project

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
title: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee faces fresh bailable warrants in 2018 defamation case

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: The midterm elections in the United States are approaching, and results may affect trade relations with India. A Democratic win could lead to increased scrutiny of current trade policies, including tariffs and government spending. However, significant policy changes are not expected immediately following the elections. The investment landscape for artificial intelligence and data centres is unlikely to face substantial shifts.
title: US midterm elections: What a Democratic win could mean for India's trade

author: SANDEEP RAGHAVAN
description: In Anantapur district, a male assailant attacked a tenth-grade student named Gopika with a saw. This violent incident occurred inside a Zilla Parishad high school, shocking students and staff members alike. Another student, Lakshmi, sustained injuries while trying to intervene and protect her classmate. Local police were promptly notified and initiated a search for the suspect. Authorities are conducting a thorough investigation to apprehend the perpetrator and ensure community safety.
title: Chainsaw attack in Andhra: Class 10 girl critical after rejecting man's proposal

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Jahnvi Singh's career shift from McKinsey to Google has significantly enhanced her work-life balance and transformed her daily schedule. She now focuses on a single business, which deepens her industry expertise while reducing the need for frequent domestic travel. This change opens opportunities for international trips, and she enjoys improved workplace perks at Google. Most notably, Jahnvi has rediscovered time for fitness and socializing, which had previously been difficult.
title: IIM Calcutta alumna on how life changed after switching from McKinsey to Google

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Joan Ginther stands out in lottery history, having triumphantly won the Texas Lottery four times in 17 years, accumulating an astounding $20.4 million in total. This unprecedented success has sparked intrigue, particularly regarding her statistical background. Investigators have examined whether her victories stemmed from calculated strategies or perhaps some insider knowledge. The question remains: Is her extraordinary luck a result of clever choices or merely chance?
title: Meet Joan Ginther, who won $20m across four lottery jackpots

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: In the heart of Otsuchi, Japan, the Wind Phone stands as a poignant tribute to those who have lost loved ones. Established by Itaru Sasaki after the loss of his cousin, this unique telephone booth offers a space to share unspoken thoughts. Following the devastation of the 2011 tsunami, it has become a refuge for many grieving souls, fostering emotional connections and inspiring similar creations worldwide.
title: Japan's 'phone booth to the dead' lets people talk to lost loved ones

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: A four-person family in Bengaluru claims their monthly grocery bills range between Rs 60,000 to Rs 80,000, sparking discussions across social media platforms regarding average grocery costs. Various users chimed in, sharing their own budgeting experiences, which showcased stark contrasts in spending behaviors. The discourse emphasizes that food expenditure can be highly individualized, influenced by personal preferences and lifestyle choices.
title: Bengaluru man says family spends up to Rs 80,000 monthly on home-cooked food

author: KARAN MANRAL
title: 'Delhi Chalo' march: Kiren Rijiju's 5 questions to Congress ahead of INDIA bloc rally

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: After almost six years of legal back-and-forth, a Pennsylvania convenience store finally received the go-ahead for a drive-through window. Jyotsna and Anil Jivani's 2020 proposal faced initial denial from township officials. However, in a significant ruling from the Pennsylvania Commonwealth Court in October 2026, judges overturned the lower court's verdict, affirming that the drive-through serves as a natural extension of their business, paving the way for construction approval.
title: Pennsylvania couple's six-year fight revives truck stop drive-through plan

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Maurice Voce, a successful barber whose financial savvy amassed significant wealth, tragically deteriorated in health prior to his passing. Following his death, concerns arose about the effectiveness of his financial adviser's management amid Voce's cognitive difficulties. His family has since initiated a lawsuit against Morgan Stanley and adviser John Privitelli, alleging financial elder abuse.
title: California barber built $19m fortune; court revives elder abuse claims

author: TANUJ LAKHINA
description: Manisha Bhanwala made history as the first Indian woman to win gold at the Wrestling World Championships, overcoming a 0-6 deficit to triumph. After the win, she showcased a Tshirt with the photo of her late father, who introduced her to the sport. With her sights now set on the 57kg Olympic category for LA 2028, Manisha’s experience and resilience will be crucial for future success.
title: 'Sher ki tarah jhapatta': How Manisha overturned 0-6 deficit to win gold at Worlds

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Brian Armstrong shares his thoughts on billionaire philanthropy during an interview on the Katie Miller podcast. While he admires large donations from others, he worries about charities' potential negative societal impacts. He believes many philanthropic organizations have become captured by ideology and produce unintended consequences. Armstrong uses a donor-advised fund to control his charitable contributions and their impact.
title: Scott & French Gates, Brian Armstrong doesn’t agree with your philanthropy

author: SUBHADRA SRIVASTAVA
title: 'Historic day': PM Modi welcomes launch of Kashi-Delhi Vande Bharat sleeper train

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
title: 'Let's walk together': Rahul invites people to march ahead of INDIA bloc rally

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: A chore list shared by a user highlights parenting methods for young children and their responsibilities. The reactions indicate divided opinions on how much structure is beneficial for children. Some parents recall gaining important life skills from similar routines while others express regret about a lack of structure. Research connects children performing chores with improved competence and relationships during later school years.
title: Man shares strict chore list his dad made him follow from age 8

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: For nearly 20 years, a contentious inheritance battle has revolved around the exclusion of Davide Sidoli from his father's will. Antonio and Andrea Sidoli, asserting their rights as heirs, encountered hurdles in claiming their inheritance in England. Although Italian courts recognized their rights and awarded them over €381,000, difficulties arose in enforcing this judgment in England.
title: English court lets only €46K of €381K Italian inheritance ruling stand

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Dhruv Jurel played a crucial role for India A by scoring an unbeaten 99 in tough conditions. After losing three wickets in quick succession, India A struggled at 160 for 6 during the match. Jurel built partnerships including a vital 62-run stand with Manav Suthar, who contributed 22 runs. He remained unbeaten as India A fought back to reach a competitive total by day's end.
title: Dhruv Jurel's unbeaten 99 rescues India A after dramatic collapse against NZ A

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Filmmaker Sanjay Gupta has reportedly passed away, with Kamaal Khan paying tribute on X. Debuting with ‘Aatish: Feel the Fire’ in 1994, Gupta became known for crime dramas and stylised action, including ‘Kaante’, ‘Shootout at Wadala’, ‘Kaabil’ and ‘Mumbai Saga’. The cause of death hasn’t been disclosed.
title: Sanjay Gupta Dies: Filmmaker behind Kaante and Shootout at Wadala dies at 57

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: After their son Luke was diagnosed with Bardet-Biedl syndrome, an Arizona couple established A Race Against Blindness. The charity has since raised over $6.1 million for research into inherited retinal diseases. They also organized a sweepstakes featuring a custom adventure van, significantly increasing awareness. Their contributions support groundbreaking gene therapy aimed at BBS1, and funding has expanded to multiple inherited retinal condition studies.
title: Arizona parents turn donated van into charity fighting inherited blindness

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Google's Project Suncatcher reached a significant milestone with its first AI response from a TPU in orbit. After launching a prototype satellite, the team prompted the TPU to generate a haiku about space. The successful transmission of the poem confirmed the potential of operating AI hardware in space. Future tests will evaluate the performance of TPUs under various conditions and stress factors.
title: Google sent TPUs to space, CEO Sundar Pichai shares a 'Hello World' update

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: Ukraine is urgently requesting Patriot air defence interceptors to bolster its defense against increased Russian strikes. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy expressed concerns over potential delays in receiving these crucial missiles. The impending winter raises fears of vulnerable civilians if critical infrastructure is damaged. European countries face challenges in balancing support for Ukraine with their own defense needs.
title: 'Real danger, real need': Why Zelenskyy wants Patriot missiles before winter

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Aakash Chopra has voiced his concerns regarding India’s choice to omit Vaibhav Sooryavanshi from the lineup for the fourth T20I. He stressed the importance of clear communication about Sooryavanshi's position and future with the team. Although he had previously shown strong performance, Sooryavanshi was dropped upon Ishan Kishan’s return. Chopra suggests that if Sooryavanshi is not a priority, he should focus on gaining more experience in domestic cricket.
title: ‘Send him home’: Ex-cricketer's blunt message to Gambhir over Sooryavanshi

author: SUBHADRA SRIVASTAVA
title: Sting op row: K'taka Congress expels Kripa Alva for 6 years over Siddaramaiah video

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: Punjab polls: AAP's first list out, CM Bhagwant Mann to fight from Dhuri again

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: This year, over 300 southern right whale calves have tragically perished along the coast of Argentina, prompting alarm among marine biologists. Initial investigations suggest a bacterial infection as a likely factor in the increased death toll. Rarely observed, adult and juvenile whale fatalities are also being reported. Researchers are exploring environmental shifts that may be affecting calf survival. Despite population recovery, the lasting consequences of this mortality spike remain unknown.
title: Hundreds of baby whales have died off the coast of Argentina this year

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: During her summer break, Grace de Souza, a talented teenager from Goa, tapped into her entrepreneurial spirit by producing moringa powder from the leaves of her family's two moringa trees. Her efforts have proven fruitful, with earnings nearing Rs 3,000 from selling 20 packets. Inspired by this success, Grace plans to sustain her small business even when school resumes, embracing the lessons of hard work and responsibility.
title: 13-year-old Goan girl turns backyard moringa into powder business

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A recent ruling by a Superior Court judge has put the brakes on the proposed outdoor amphitheater at Union Grove Farm, North Carolina. The Triangle Land Conservancy raised alarms over land-use regulations intended to safeguard agricultural landscapes. This dispute stems from a conservation easement put in place during the 1990s, underscoring the ongoing conflict between developmental ambitions and environmental protection in the area.
title: Judge blocks amphitheater on protected NC farmland

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Naomi Osaka’s success in tennis is attributed to her parents’ efforts throughout her journey. Her mother, Tamaki Osaka, worked tirelessly to support her daughters' tennis ambitions and expenses. Leonard François, Naomi’s father, self-taught himself the sport to coach both daughters after being inspired by the Williams sisters. Their different approaches provided a solid foundation for Naomi's career as a professional player.
title: How Naomi Osaka's parents fueled her tennis dreams

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: TJ Hoover II's case raised critical alarms when he showed signs of life just before organ retrieval, prompting intense scrutiny of patient safety protocols. Testimony from Donna Rhorer revealed disturbing insights about operational practices. Federal investigations uncovered multiple alarming incidents, leading to possible decertification for the Network for Hope, as the family demands accountability.
title: US organ group faces decertification after donor woke up

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Dinesh Karthik asserts that India should consider resting Abhishek Sharma if they wish to include Vaibhav Sooryavanshi in the lineup. This comes after Sooryavanshi missed the fourth T20I, allowing Ishan Kishan to recover. While Sanju Samson has shown promise, his recent form has dipped, making it crucial to balance team dynamics. With the series against New Zealand secured, the last T20I serves as a platform to experiment with combinations.
title: ‘If you want to fit Vaibhav’: Ex-cricketer's message to Gambhir on Sooryavanshi

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI, expresses his views on AI tokens during a podcast with John Collison. He argues that AI tokens are not a good measure of business value despite their popularity among customers. Altman believes customers prefer clarity in pricing and are uncomfortable with vague billing methods. He highlights that customers would rather pay more for consistent token amounts, even if inflated.
title: Altman calls AI tokens ‘fake’ that Nvidia CEO offered to pay engineers beyond salary

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
title: 'You're damaging his image': Congress counters Amit Shah's 'sideline Patel' charge

author: SUBHADRA SRIVASTAVA
title: 'Coup d'etat' or rule of law? Why Poland's PM & president are locked in a standoff

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: During his concert in New Delhi, Diljit Dosanjh responded to criticism regarding his political views. He emphasized his identity as an artist and expressed support for all attendees. Dosanjh defended his film on human rights activist Jaswant Singh Khalra, which was ridiculed by critics. Abhijeet Dipke, a member of Cockroach Janta Party, addressed Diljit on social media regarding their disagreement.
title: 'Punjabion ko naa sikhaao...': Diljit Dosanjh's pointed message amid CJP row

author: RAJIV KALKOD
description: On Friday evening, two foreign nationals from Germany and Slovakia died from suspected electrocution in a hotel swimming pool. A US national and an Indian pool attendant were injured while trying to rescue them. Both the injured individuals were taken to Manipal Hospital for treatment, and they are currently reported to be out of danger. Police have initiated an investigation to determine the circumstances surrounding the incident.
title: German, Slovak nationals die in Bengaluru hotel pool; US tourist among injured

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: India has included fast bowler Auqib Nabi in their squad for the first three ODIs against New Zealand. This decision follows an injury to Prasidh Krishna, who will miss the entire ODI series. Nitish Kumar Reddy will remain with the ODI squad before joining India A for a four-day match. The two-Test series against New Zealand is scheduled to commence on November 19.
title: Auqib Nabi added to India squad for first three ODIs against New Zealand

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: At 59 years old, Dolly Rana has passionately launched a bus service in Howrah, West Bengal, all to fulfill her late father's dream of bus ownership. Amidst the pandemic and increasing competition, she embraced the role of conductor, showcasing her tenacity. With support from local transport authorities, she obtained a new route permit, driving her business forward. Her journey truly embodies resilience and the honoring of a cherished promise.
title: Howrah woman becomes bus conductor to fulfill late father's dream

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Workers are currently deploying three million pounds of recycled concrete drainage pipes to create artificial reefs on the seabed. This innovative project intends to boost marine habitats for local fish species, enhancing both fishing and diving experiences. Positioned between four and eight nautical miles off East Pass, the varied depths of the sites will facilitate diverse marine life.
title: Florida sinks 1,500 tons of concrete off Destin to create 3 reefs

author: SUBHADRA SRIVASTAVA
title: PM Modi pays tribute to Sardar Patel at Statue of Unity on 151st birth anniversary

author: MAHIMA SHARMA
description: External affairs minister S Jaishankar had a productive meeting with US secretary of state Marco Rubio in Atlanta to explore avenues for enhanced bilateral ties. They shared reflections from their recent talks during the G20 foreign ministers' summit. Jaishankar's itinerary also included dialogues with both the US ambassador to India and India's ambassador to the US, highlighting active diplomatic channels.
title: Jaishankar, Rubio review India-US bilateral cooperation during Atlanta meeting

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: In an inspiring project, eighth-grader Locklyn Raye Ward from Oklahoma explored the antibacterial capabilities of wild plants. Analyzing 24 plants sourced from her family’s farm, she found that 56 percent demonstrated antibacterial effects, but none were as potent as commercial antibiotics. Interestingly, seven native plants showcased promising antibiotic properties, prompting Locklyn to highlight the importance of wild plants while addressing the significant issue of antibiotic overuse.
title: Oklahoma 8th-grader finds 56% of wild plants show antibacterial activity

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Canada's immigration authority emphasizes that international students may work only if their study permits allow it. Students can work off campus for a maximum of 24 hours per week during study sessions. Violating these work conditions can lead to serious repercussions, including loss of student status. Furthermore, unauthorized work may result in a permanent record of fraud with IRCC and a five-year return ban.
title: Canada sets this condition for international students looking to work there

author: RK LAXMI
description: Mugdha Deshmukh, a 34-year-old woman who returned to India, was found dead in Pune this week. Her family was unaware of her return and suspected something was wrong when she could not be contacted. They discovered food delivery transactions that indicated her presence in India, prompting further investigation. Police located her rented apartment and found her body without visible injuries.
title: Woman who secretly returned from UK without informing family found dead in Pune flat

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Mitchell Santner etched his name in history as the top wicket-taker against India in T20 internationals, achieving 32 dismissals. This remarkable feat occurred during the fourth T20I, where he claimed two wickets. He also celebrated reaching the 150-wicket milestone in T20Is. With a dominant 87-run victory, New Zealand earned their first win of the series, narrowing India's lead to 3-1.
title: Nemesis No. 1! Mitchell Santner scripts history, enters record books against India

author: NASEER GANAI
title: Omar faces NC storm: Many MLAs upset over J&K cabinet rejig, Srinagar MP to quit

author: PRIYANKA JAISWAL
title: Dosas, temple visits: US midterm candidates step up outreach to Indian-American voters

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: The US state department has authorized the potential sale of 500 PAC-3 interceptors to Ukraine. This deal, valued at $2.1 billion, reflects Ukraine's ongoing military support needs. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy emphasized the urgency of immediate deliveries to address winter threats. The planned delivery timelines have raised concerns regarding the effectiveness of Ukraine's defense capabilities. Zelenskyy has requested a winter support package involving immediate supplies from existing stocks.
title: US clears $2.1 billion Patriot missile deal for Ukraine, allies to pay

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Many teenagers find themselves replaying conversations in their heads as a way to handle their feelings and gear up for tough situations. While this is a common practice also seen in adults, it often serves as a constructive method for emotional processing instead of mere unhealthy ruminating. Research shows that mentally rehearsing interactions can enhance one's confidence in facing challenging conversations with peers or authority.
title: Teens rehearsing comebacks may be processing hidden emotions: Psychology

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Mayar Othman Al Shourbagy, an 11-year-old student from Egypt, won the 10th Arab Reading Challenge. Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum presented her with a badge to commemorate her achievement. She read 60 books as part of her preparation for the competition. The challenge attracted over 40 million participants from 60 countries, promoting a culture of reading. Mayar's family and school supported her throughout her reading journey.
title: 11-year-old Egyptian girl beats 40M students in reading contest

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: In the fourth T20I against New Zealand, Nitish Reddy had a tough outing, giving away 64 runs and ranking as the second-most expensive bowler in T20I history for India. New Zealand set an impressive target of 259 runs, winning the match by 87 runs and narrowing India’s series lead to 3-1. Glenn Phillips played a vital role with his half-century, while India struggled to reach just 172 runs in response.
title: Nitish Reddy joins unwanted list after horror outing against New Zealand

author: SUBHADRA SRIVASTAVA
title: Fake US voters? China-linked accounts flood X with divisive posts ahead of midterms

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: On October 29, 2026, Project Angel Food initiated construction of the Community Outreach Center in Hollywood. This new building will enhance client services and nutrition education for individuals facing serious illnesses. The project, supported by The Chuck Lorre Family Foundation, aims to expand meal preparation and outreach programs. As part of a multiyear campaign, the expanded facilities will elevate the organisation's role in the Food Is Medicine movement.
title: Chuck Lorre's charity breaks ground on final building, serves 1.5m meals

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Facing heightened scrutiny from immigration authorities, major tech firms such as Google and Meta are resisting federal subpoenas. This pushback reflects their tension over increasing government demands for user information, raising alarms about privacy. Industry leaders worry about navigating legal complexities and potential backlash, with Congress expected to scrutinize these practices more closely after the upcoming midterm elections.
title: Google, Meta and other tech companies resist ICE demands for user data

title: ‘Architect of Akhand Bharat’: PM Modi, Amit Shah pay tribute to Sardar Patel

author: GAURAV GUPTA
description: As the Mumbai Indians strategize for IPL 2027, they are contemplating bringing Rohit Sharma back as captain while also considering trading Hardik Pandya to another team. With Kieron Pollard leading a revamped coaching staff that includes Robin Uthappa and T Dilip, MI aims for a turnaround after finishing ninth in the previous season.
title: Rohit Sharma likely to lead Mumbai Indians again, Tilak Varma could be deputy

author: SUBHADRA SRIVASTAVA
title: 'My body hurts, my soul hurts': Christa Pike after failed execution in US

author: DISHANK PUROHIT
description: Senior IAS officer Shikhar Agrawal faces a preliminary inquiry by the Anti-Corruption Bureau. He has been accused of misusing his official position to benefit Goyal Fashions Private Limited. The inquiry includes alleged irregularities in the purchase of villas by Agrawal and his family members. Agrawal reportedly secured financial benefits for the company while he was in charge of industries.
title: '20 villas in Udaipur, 8 in Alwar': Why IAS officer, IPS wife face ACB probe

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: US-Iran deal on horizon? Uranium transfer, Hormuz reopening in 7 days proposed

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce donated $26 million to charities across the US, supporting food banks, children's hospitals, education and animal welfare. Their $1 million contribution to New York's City Harvest is expected to help provide food to more than 2.4 million residents this summer. Several nonprofit leaders expressed shock and gratitude after learning about the unexpected gifts, which arrived as many communities face growing financial and food insecurity.
title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce donate $1 million to feed 2.4 million New Yorkers

author: KUSHAGRA DIXIT
description: The national capital region will implement a complete ban on construction and demolition activities from November 5 to 20. This measure is part of a broader initiative to combat rising winter pollution levels. Union environment minister Bhupender Yadav confirmed that there would be no rollback of existing vehicle entry restrictions. Additionally, swift actions will target non-conforming industries and pollution hotspots in the region.
title: Total construction ban in Delhi-NCR from Nov 5 to 20

author: VAIBHAV GANJAPURE
description: The Bombay High Court has mandated that the Maharashtra government compensate activist Arun Ferreira with Rs 2 lakh. This ruling was based on the violation of Ferreira's fundamental rights under Articles 21 and 22, as he was arrested without valid identification and was not informed of the reasons for his detention.
title: Activist Arun Ferreira's arrest illegal, give him Rs 2 lakh: Bombay HC

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Miami-Dade is facing an estimated shortage of 118,000 affordable housing units, prompting a $53 million project in Homestead, Florida. Nonprofit Touching Miami with Love plans to transform unused land behind its existing community centre into a five-storey development with 100 affordable homes. The project is expected to break ground in 2027, offering relief to families struggling with rising rents.
title: $53M project to build 100 affordable homes amid Miami-Dade shortage

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Former India all-rounder Yuvraj Singh believes young batters Abhishek Sharma, Ishan Kishan and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi deserve more opportunities in 50-over cricket. Yuvraj feels that not regularly considering these players for the ODI team does not do justice to their talent. He also hopes they get a place in the squad soon.
title: 'Not doing justice': Yuvraj Singh wants Abhishek and Sooryavanshi in ODIs

author: PRIYANKA JAISWAL
title: Alaska Airlines to cut 200 jobs as Iran war-driven fuel costs threaten $700 million loss

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: An elementary teacher in Kansas has implemented positive affirmations at the end of each school day. This practice has spread across various grades, enhancing students' sense of belonging and value. While affirmations alone do not replace effective teaching methods, they contribute to a supportive classroom atmosphere. Parents can also foster encouragement in their children by acknowledging their feelings and individuality.
title: Kansas teacher's daily affirmations spread to other classrooms

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: 'India's self-reliance in critical technologies': PM Modi on Isro's NVS-03 success

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: After leaving her Rs 50 LPA corporate career to support her daughter Shivika’s chess ambitions, Nidhi Bhasin Rohilla discovered gaps in Delhi’s chess ecosystem. She set out to build what was missing, creating an academy, tournaments, and communities for players across ages and abilities. Today, her initiatives span eight states, championing accessibility, inclusion and a culture where chess thrives beyond ratings, titles and competition.
title: A mother who had to quit her Rs 50 LPA job, now changing chess scene in North India

author: SUBHADRA SRIVASTAVA
title: Trump administration to deport 150 Afghan refugees to Afghanistan via Pakistan

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Glenn Phillips, during the fourth T20I against India, walked out to bat after Daryl Mitchell was dismissed off the fifth ball of the third over, bowled by Mayank Yadav. He first exchanged a fist bump with opening batter Finn Allen. As he began walking towards the crease, the DJ played The Time Is Now, John Cena's famous entrance theme.
title: 'The Time Is Now': How Phillips turned a John Cena moment into India's nightmare

author: HADI KHAN
description: A fire broke out at a shoe manufacturing factory in Delhi's Mangolpuri Industrial Area, which killed four individuals. Firefighters responded quickly and managed to rescue six people trapped inside the building. Two injured victims were taken to Sanjay Gandhi Memorial Hospital for treatment following the incident. The cause of the fire is currently under investigation by local authorities and police personnel.
title: 4 killed, 2 injured in fire at Delhi shoe factory; owner summoned

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In an imaginative twist on Halloween festivities, Kelly Hertel evolved his childhood fears into an engaging front yard display dubbed Terroride. Generating significant charity donations, the attraction is an elaborate homage to his past. With over 400 hours of meticulous effort, Hertel's themed sections offer both thrilling entertainment and a chance for the community to unite in giving this season.
title: Utah man's 400-hour Halloween display fills half his truck with donations

author: NITESH DUBEY
description: After four years of chasing an India comeback, Poonam Raut has called time on her international career. In an exclusive conversation with TimesofIndia.com, the former India batter reflects on her retirement, the sacrifices her parents made to support her cricketing dream, her 86-run knock in the 2017 Women's World Cup final and the messages from young girls inspired by India's campaign. She also discusses women's cricket's growth and her plans to mentor young cricketers.
title: ‘I did everything I could for India’: Poonam Raut on retirement and unfinished dream
